lines: Last night three hundred and twenty-eight men crawled out to mend the wire.
When the flares went up, one hundred and thirty-five were hit.
By morning, one hundred and eight had fallen.
The Hegemony medics reached only two in three.
Three nights ago, a Concord raider jumped into the trench of Gideon Cubes.
Cubes fought him off. Today his rifle is the deadliest on the front. Five enemies down.
Medic Hugo Magnusmadsen has patched up twenty-eight men. Yesterday a bullet hit his belt buckle. Today he was back.
Cyril Catatfire bought War Bonds, then went out on the wire. He did not come back.
His dog Jasper waited at the grave. Then the heir came up the line.
Wendel Gonzo joined the Field Post. Thank you.
Bone Quarry: Hegemony ninety-one, Concord eighty-eight.
Fifty-two new soldiers came up the line yesterday.
Two thousand one hundred and fifty-nine now hold the front.
One thousand one hundred and fifty-nine Concord.
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the line.
